claims.evidence: Lens cap is on and LCD screen is not shown open/lit, so cleanliness and sharpness cannot be assessed from the photos.
No import sticker, serial number, or packaging shown to confirm origin.
Photo 0 shows 'EOS 650D' text and Canon branding; Photo 2 shows zoom ring markings 18-24-35-55 consistent with a standard 18-55mm kit lens.
No photo shows the camera powered on, screen lit, or a shutter actuation; witness only shows it held, screen closed.

risks.proof: Short video of camera powering on, menu navigating, and shutter firing

risks.risk: High shutter count reducing remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from EOS Info or similar tool

risks.risk: LCD screen damage (cracked, dead pixels, discoloration)
risks.proof: Photo of screen open and powered on showing a live image or menu

risks.risk: Lens glass issues (scratches, fungus, haze, dust)
risks.proof: Photo of front and rear lens elements with cap off, lit from an angle

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories (battery, charger, memory card)
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as body/lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Sensor dust, dead pixels, or sensor damage
risks.proof: A test photo of a plain white/blank surface at small aperture

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage on bottom or battery compartment
risks.proof: Photo of camera base and open battery/SD compartment
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible unseen damage

risks.risk: Unverified 'UK Used' origin claim, could affect warranty/history expectations

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, menu use, and shutter firing
Photo of LCD screen powered on
Photo of lens front/rear elements with cap removed
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, cables, memory card)
Test photo of blank surface to check sensor
Photo of camera bottom and battery compartment
Photo of serial number or UK import marking
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a Canon EOS 650D DSLR with an 18-55mm kit lens, so it can be priced, but functionality, screen condition, lens glass, shutter count, and accessories are all unverified and must be priced at worst case until proven.
